card.title: TicketSage
card.subtitle: Movie Ticket Booking Platform
card.summary: Django movie booking platform (TMDB, auth, showtimes) - group software engineering course competition winner at University of Ilorin; backend-led.

detail.overview: TicketSage is a full-stack movie booking system built with Django REST Framework (backend) and Next.js (frontend). It integrates with the TMDB API to fetch movie data, allows users to browse listings, select seats, and book tickets, while providing an admin dashboard for cinema and booking management. My main role focused on building the backend architecture, APIs, and booking logic.

spans.text: powering RESTful APIs for movies, users, bookings, and payments.
Custom Django management commands to refresh movie lists and generate showtimes automatically.
Secure sign-up/login with dj-rest-auth, token-based authentication, and CSRF protection.
SQLite for development, with models for movies, cinemas, showtimes, and bookings.
Backend hosted on PythonAnywhere, frontend deployed on Vercel.
Browse movies, view details, select seats, book tickets, and manage profile.
Manage cinemas, movies, showtimes, users, and bookings from a secure dashboard.
Built with Next.js and Zustand for state management; communicates with Django APIs.
Enforced HTTPS, password hashing, and token-based authentication.
Unit, integration, and UAT all passed successfully.
Smooth booking process; user feedback praised ease of use but highlighted improvements needed in seat availability visibility and faster load times.

problem.title: Challenge: Automated Movie & Showtime Updates
problem.issue: Keeping the movie catalog and showtimes fresh required constant manual input.
problem.impact: Admin workload increased and users risked outdated listings.

solution.title: Solution: Custom Management Commands
solution.implementation: Built Django commands to fetch data from TMDB and auto-generate showtimes on a schedule.
solution.result: Catalog and showtimes always up-to-date with zero manual intervention.

problem.title: Challenge: Seat Booking Consistency
problem.issue: High concurrency during booking risked double-seating issues.
problem.impact: Could result in multiple users booking the same seat.

solution.title: Solution: Transactional Safeguards
solution.implementation: Used Django transactions and locks to ensure seat availability is checked and updated atomically.
